summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a press release announcing that its Sangdong processing and crushing facilities in Yeongwol, South Korea, received mining facility inspection certificates issued September 17, 2026, authorizing commercial operation. This is the final administrative step enabling Almonty to process tungsten ore into saleable concentrate and commence commercial sales. A July 2026 offtake amendment with Global Tungsten Powders extended the term to 21 years and increased contracted volume to 4,410,000 MTU, covering over 90% of Phase I production. This is an operational milestone, not a special-situation transaction.
